title: Oozy Gooey Middle Eastern Lamb Maqluba
description: A flavorful and gooey Middle Eastern dish featuring lamb, mustard, and parmesan cheese, perfect for a meal prep dinner option, this recipe is low in sodium and incorporates tadka for added depth of flavor
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium high heat and sear the lamb pieces until browned on all sides
Add the chopped onion to the skillet and cook until softened
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook for 1 minute
Stir in the brown mustard and tadka spice blend and cook for 1 minute
In a large bowl, combine the cooked lamb mixture, basmati rice, and low sodium chicken broth
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish and top with shredded parmesan cheese
Cover the dish with aluminum foil and bake for 30 minutes
Remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 20 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly
